description: Search live empty leg flights (whole aircraft, discounted repositioning flights) by origin, destination, date window, passengers, market and an optional price ceiling. Returns up to `limit` legs (default 5, max 20) with route, departure window, aircraft and seats, the whole-aircraft price in local currency, estimated taxes, an all-in estimate, the full-charter comparison and a booking link. Operators are not named on empty legs. Inventory changes constantly; re-run rather than reuse old results.

currency.description: Optional 3-letter currency to add an indicative conversion and to read max_price in, e.g. USD or EUR.

destination.description: Arrival city or airport, e.g. "Mumbai", "BOM", "VABB", "Teterboro" or "KTEB".

limit.description: How many legs to return (1 to 20, default 5).

market.description: Market by country, e.g. "India", "US", "UK", "UAE" (list_markets has the full list). Optional.

max_price.description: Price ceiling for the whole aircraft, in `currency` when given, else in each leg's own currency.

origin.description: Departure city or airport, e.g. "Mumbai", "BOM", "VABB", "Teterboro" or "KTEB".

passengers.description: Number of passengers (legs with fewer seats are excluded).

name: search_empty_legs
title: Search empty leg flights
